rawFindings.title: AUTH failure with callback continues into success path
rawFindings.explanation: When `AUTH` fails and an `auth_callback` is set, this new branch invokes the callback and clears it but does not return. Execution then continues to `res = res.toString()`, but Redis error replies call this callback with no `res`, causing a TypeError after the user callback is invoked.
rawFindings.suggestion: Return after calling and clearing `self.auth_callback` in this error branch.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Against a password-protected Redis server, `client.auth('wrong-password', cb)` before connect calls `cb(err)` and then throws `TypeError: Cannot read property 'toString' of undefined` instead of only reporting the AUTH error via the callback.
